# The owner's recipes — DATA, never prose

Owner law, 2026-08-27: **EVERY agent on this list IS THE `claude` BINARY. Only the environment changes.**
CLAUDE, CODEX, AGY, ZAI, MINIMAX, FUGU, GROK — all of them. There is no vendor CLI on the path, and
there NEVER was. What changes a provider is `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` pointing at the proxy plus the
`ANTHROPIC_*_MODEL` variables; the proxy translates the wire.

**Why this file exists.** These recipes lived in `CLAUDE.md` as prose and were lost
in a rewrite — for the third time. The owner pasted them back on 2026-08-29 saying "I pasted that
block about 10 times". Prose fails nobody: `test_owner_recipes.py` reads THIS file and compares what
nSPAWN actually builds against each block below. Editing a block changes what the product must do.

Single rule since 2026-09-04 (the recipe the owner types by hand): `OPUS`, `SONNET` and
`SUBAGENT` carry the model; `HAIKU` carries `model_fast`; the effort goes in `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL`.
FUGU and AGY lost the `SONNET`/`SUBAGENT` = fast they had on 2026-08-29.

## CLAUDE

```bash
CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=$OAUTH_TOKEN CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=800000 claude --append-system-prompt-file $NOTT_PLUGIN/NOTT.md -p {prompt}
```

## CODEX

```bash
ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=$NOTT_PROXY_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$PROXY_BASE_URL ANTHROPIC_MODEL=$PROXY_CODEX_DEFAULT_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL=$PROXY_CODEX_DEFAULT_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL=$PROXY_CODEX_DEFAULT_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL=$PROXY_CODEX_FAST_MODEL CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=$PROXY_CODEX_DEFAULT_MODEL CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT=1 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=200000 CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=max claude --append-system-prompt-file $NOTT_PLUGIN/NOTT.md -p {prompt}
```

## FUGU

```bash
ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=$API_KEY ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$SAKANA_BASE_URL ANTHROPIC_MODEL=$SAKANA_DEFAULT_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL=$SAKANA_DEFAULT_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL=$SAKANA_DEFAULT_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL=$SAKANA_FAST_MODEL CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=$SAKANA_DEFAULT_MODEL CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT=1 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=800000 claude --append-system-prompt-file $NOTT_PLUGIN/NOTT.md -p {prompt}
```

## AGY

```bash
ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=$NOTT_PROXY_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$PROXY_BASE_URL ANTHROPIC_MODEL=$PROXY_GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL=$PROXY_GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL=$PROXY_GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL=$PROXY_GEMINI_FAST_MODEL CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=$PROXY_GEMINI_DEFAULT_MODEL CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT=1 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=800000 CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=high claude --append-system-prompt-file $NOTT_PLUGIN/NOTT.md -p {prompt}
```
